scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @instaframe/api" "npm run dev -w @instaframe/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @instaframe/contracts && npm run build -w @instaframe/api && npm run build -w @instaframe/web && npm run build -w @instaframe/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @instaframe/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
